name: Accordion · plant care guide
description: Plant care tips over a leafy photo with centred text.

items.question: Light
items.answer: Most houseplants prefer bright, indirect light. Avoid midday sun on leaves.

items.question: Water
items.answer: Water when the top two centimetres of soil feel dry, then let excess drain away.

items.question: Temperature
items.answer: Keep plants between 16 and 24 degrees and away from radiators and draughts.

items.question: Repotting
items.answer: Repot every one to two years in spring, choosing a pot only slightly larger.
